label: Surface photographs
credit: Vernadsky Institute and Moscow Power Institute; distributed by the NASA PDS Geosciences Node
qualification: Exact institutional archive files. These are historical camera panoramas with the source archive's assembly and tonal processing, not modern restorations.

items.label: Venera 9 · 1975
items.alt: Black-and-white Venera 9 surface panorama showing angular rocks, soil, the horizon, and part of the lander.
items.caption: One of the first photos returned from the surface of another planet; angular rocks and lander hardware are visible.

items.label: Venera 10 · 1975
items.alt: Black-and-white Venera 10 surface panorama showing flat rock slabs, fine material, and parts of the lander.
items.caption: Flat rock slabs and fine surface material appear beneath diffuse daylight; spacecraft parts occupy the foreground.

items.label: Venera 13 · 1982
items.alt: Two black-and-white Venera 13 surface panoramas showing slab-like rocks, soil, calibration targets, and lander hardware.
items.caption: Two camera panoramas show slab-like rocks, soil, calibration targets, and lander hardware.

items.label: Venera 14 · 1982
items.alt: Two black-and-white Venera 14 surface panoramas showing layered rock slabs and parts of the lander.
items.caption: Two camera panoramas show layered rock slabs and spacecraft hardware at the landing site.
